input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 imposes insurance obligations on the Vendor at levels that meet our preferred position in full: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional errors and omissions of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M (appropriate given Vendor processes Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law, all maintained throughout the term plus a one-year tail. Section 18.2 adds insurer quality, certificates of insurance on request, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — additional protections in our favour. No redline required.
